comparison.objective: Join two lower robot-leg links by clicking a stud into a jaw; unlike commissioning a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bring articulated links into alignment and perform snap-fit insertion; no setscrew unlocking, fine collar rotation, or cycle-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Orange stud must click into blue jaw and the robot must release. Engagement-force/tolerance details and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests constrained link alignment and snap latching rather than adjustable damping.
